title: StashAway首席配置官：定期投入优于择时，中国市场同样适用
speaker: Stephanie Lung

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, that's something very interesting work recently. And next week, we're going to publish our periodical monthly sales insights that talks about that. And basically, the insight that we've found is what we're trying to compare is, let's say for investors who buys at every dip of 10% dip, 20% dip, 30% dip, how does that compare to somebody who just invest regularly? Let's say on a monthly basis.
segments.zh: 这是我们最近一项有趣的研究。下周我们将发布月度销售洞察。我们比较了两种策略：一种是每次下跌10%、20%、30%时买入，另一种是每月定期投入。

segments.en: I think intuitively, you would think that actually the investor who can buy on a dip on every dip would beat the regular investor. But in reality, when we ran the numbers, the regular investors actually win both of the time and buy a pretty wide margin over five years, 10 year, 15 year time Verizon. And I think the reason behind that is actually quite logical. So if you think about the dip buyer, they have to wait for the dip. But actually, bull markets run a lot longer than the bear markets. So you have to wait for a long time in that dip to come.
segments.zh: 直觉上，每次下跌都买入的投资者应该跑赢定期投入者。但实际数据表明，定期投入者在5年、10年、15年维度上始终胜出，且优势明显。原因很合理：下跌买入者必须等待下跌，但牛市持续时间远长于熊市，等待下跌的成本很高。

segments.en: And by waiting, that's actually the most expensive game in a market because you lose out to all those games. The underlying premise there is there needs to be a sustain bull market. Yes. Does that apply in a market like China, where it's always tactical and the index would be at the same level periodically over the period of 20 years at about the same level, where it's a different set of opportunities. How does it work in China?
segments.zh: 等待是市场上最昂贵的游戏，因为你会错过所有涨幅。但前提是存在持续牛市。在中国这样的市场，指数20年来基本持平，机会不同，定投策略是否适用？

segments.en: So I mean, even if you look at China, it's arguably perhaps one of the worst performing markets in recent years. I mean, the total return is still positive. So if you get the dividends, etc., that's still like a, we're sloping line. The slope is, of course, less steep than the US market. So if you were to dollar cost average in China, probably your gains would be lower than that in the US. But still, I mean, you make out for that volatility exactly because you dollar cost average. Not just price, yeah, absolutely.
segments.zh: 即使是中国，近年表现相对较弱，但总回报仍为正。加上股息等，收益曲线仍是向上倾斜的，只是斜率小于美国市场。在中国做定投，收益可能低于美国，但正是通过定投，你从波动中获益，而不仅仅是价格。
